foundry_calls.text: The world comes in waves — torchlight, then dark, then torchlight again. Your fingers are still curled around your sword hilt. You are dying, but not done.
foundry_calls.speaker: Sage

foundry_calls.text: Roll a death saving throw (flat d20, 10 or higher to hold on).
foundry_calls.speaker: Aria

llm_calls: [Aria]: It's my turn — what do I do now that I'm at 0 hit points?
